notes.title: 1.32 Small bug fix patch
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT'S NEW[/h3]

- Fixed the bard summon button description to properly reflect the current debuff from other bards. Also fixed the bard skill description to correctly display the debuff as 1% for each other bard. If you enjoyed/ are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review! They help me a lot and I really appreciate the feedback.

notes.title: 1.2 New game+ and Prestige Update!
notes.content:
[h3]NEW GAME+ AND PRESTIGE POINTS[/h3]

- New game+ unlocks after beating the game for the first time.
- New game + walls have more HP and powerful new resistances and abilities.
- Four NG+ modes to unlock.
- Unlock prestige points in NG+ to spend on powerful super upgrades.
- Use prestige points to take skills higher, buff the multipliers and unlock 10x new legendary items. 
- Reset your prestige points at any time, no restart required! 
- Prestige points persist between games, and will purify your soul?

[h3]SKILL AND ITEMS[/h3]

- New Auto-gauntlet item unlocks early and will click on your behalf!
- Better support for orb-clicking: Orb Feedback now deals damage based on click mana. Soul Resonance becomes Orb Studies, Wizard glass and Gathering now buff click mana.  Wiz glass can now also fully prevent cracking. 
- Replaced 'Seepage' with 'Strength in Numbers' a new skill that buffs damage for every 100 minions.
- Bone Royalty and Mimicry skills now buff the summoned minions.
- Magnify now buffs poison dagger.
- Spider damage buffed. Insect plague now buffs spider also. 
- Mystics buffed, they now boost damage of bone spear for every Mystic on the field.
- Mana Rock, Rudis and Holy Vial now scale up as walls are defeated. 
- Some smaller balance changes aimed at making more strategies viable. 

[h3]QUALITY-OF-LIFE[/h3]

- New summon limit control! Set the maximum number of skeletons, goblins or cultists to auto-summon. Takes the guesswork out of army management!
- SFX for menus and items. 
- Zoom effect for skills and spells. 
- Fixed some bugs with hover info panels. 
- Improved performance. 
- Added UI toggle for  auto-gauntlet. 


I would like to say a massive thank you to all the players! To everyone who has bought the game, played it, or even sent feedback, I appreciate it more than I can express. 

This will be the last major update for Incrementalia! I really hope that you enjoy it, I tried to pack as much in as I could. 

I will make some smaller balance changes and bug patches. Moving forward, I'll be working on a brand new incremental game project, TBA soon! 

Thank you!
-Adam

notes.title: 1.12 Improved saving, performance and skill buffs
notes.content:
BUG

- Deployed a fix to prevent wiping the save file in the event of corruption (could occur in power outage or similar). A Backup save file is now kept locally in the PlayerPrefs, which will be used in case the main file is corrupted. This should be quite robust, but won't help anyone already affected. 
- Fixed a memory leak caused by a Unity allocation texture bug. This should help performance and reduce crashes when running the game long-term. 
- Fixed a bug with boozookas getting stuck on endless mode. 
- Fixed Mana Fang readout to display correctly. 
- Fixed minion sprites getting rotated.

BALANCE

- Buffed Overseer damage +60%
- Buffed Mystic attack speed +30%, small base damage buff. 
- Buffed Gathering's effect +250%.
- Buffed Banners effect +50%. 
- Buffed Gobuchet damage +25%.
- Buffed Knight damage +50%.
- Buffed Heavy Weapons damage buff +66%.
- Buffed Hugger damage +20%. 
- Buffed Blood golem damage +100%. 
- Devil's buff from Cultist's increased +60%. 
- Buffed Seepage Poison amount +100%.
- Entreat damage buff +33%. 
- Buffed Insect damage +100%. 
- Buffed Wizard Glass effect +33%
- Buffed Bonesley's Bones. 

PERFORMANCE

- Improved performance when spamming many spells eg. chain lightning. 
- Improved RAM usage slightly. 


As always thanks for playing!! I really appreciate everyone who sent in bug reports and feedback. If you're having issues, please ping me on discord and I will do my best to help. Now that I think major bugs are done I hope to have NG+ coming within the next week or so. 

If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review! They help me immensely. 

Cheers,
Adam (Travers DePorc)

notes.title: Demo v2 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm happy to announce a massive update to the Journey to incrementalia demo, bringing it closer to what the final experience would be like. 

[h1]WHAT'S NEW?[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added side quests and items: explore the world on the side, and bring back treasures and souls for your cause. 

[*] New skill unlocking: Skills now unlock every 4 walls. The demo can now access 3 new skills, and progress up to wall 17. 

[*] New orb cracking mechanic: over-pondering can cause your orb to crack, be careful!

[*] Added hot-keys for quick menu control.

[*] Unit costs are now balanced based on how many are summoned.

[*] Fireball mana is now capped by the skill level.

[*] Minor balance and bug fixes.
[/list]


Thanks so much to everyone who has played! I'm working hard on finishing the full game at the moment. 

If you have feedback or suggestions, or just want to chat about the game, why not [url=https://discord.gg/MJRsfCXQSx]join the discord[/url]? 

Cheers!
-Adam

NOTE: if you are mid-way through the older version of the demo, you have run into unexpected issues. I recommend you use the option to delete all data, on the escape menu.
